visual_target: full-screen construction-site game HUD inspired by the user-provided reference composition
principles: Field/world art occupies the majority of the screen.
HUD stays at screen edges and uses translucent dark glass instead of page-like white cards.
Dialogue and choices float over the field at the bottom.
Current situation/title is presented as a compact left-side field card.
Strategy view keeps actual site art dominant and places workers, risk signals and zones directly on the site.
Existing event topology, choice ids and effect bundles remain unchanged.

screens.narrative: full-bleed scene + top status bar + left situation card + bottom dialogue/choice HUD
screens.strategy: full-site art + dark top status bar + left control rail + direct worker/risk overlays + compact bottom roster/action HUD

next_art_requirement: Replace remaining RC SVG environments with final cinematic construction-site raster/WebP art.
Produce dedicated TBM, stop-work, site-office/report, dusk-result and strategy-overview key art.
Keep character silhouettes, PPE, helmet colors and construction details consistent across scenes.
